amendment.name: Food Safety and Standards (Laboratory and Sample Analysis) Amendment Regulations, 2026
amendment.new_regulation_2_5_future_method_hierarc: From 1 April 2027, use FSSAI amended/adopted manuals; if method for parameter is unavailable there, FSSAI text permits validated methods prescribed by enumerated standard-setting/regulatory agencies.
amendment.new_regulation_2_6_future_timelines: From 1 April 2027, 14 days regulatory analyst/referral reports with reason-for-delay route; 5 days import reports with reason-for-delay route.
amendment.full_text_provenance: Official FSSAI Gazette notifications listing verified by web retrieval. Gazette ID/direct PDF identified but primary PDF bytes not retrievable during this review; operative text/effective date cross-checked against GazetteTracker and TaxGuru full-text republications. Future date must be independently revalidated against gazette if revised.
